[[Megumi Hayashibara]] }} '''Nurse Joy's Audino''' (Japanese: '''ジョーイのタブンネ''' ''Joy's Tabunne'') are {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by almost all [[Nurse Joy]]s in the [[Unova]] [[region]], as well as some in the [[Decolore Islands]] and the [[Kalos]] region. ==In animation== ===History=== ====''Pokémon the Series''==== [[File:Nurse Joy and Audino.png|thumb|left|250px|Nurse Joy and her Audino]] ====={{aniseries|BW}}===== Unlike the Nurse Joys of other regions, the Joys of Unova use Audino. The first Nurse Joy seen with an Audino appeared in ''[[BW006|Dreams by the Yard Full!]]''. They serve the same function as Chansey, helping Nurse Joy take care of Pokémon, including carrying them around on stretchers and helping to heal them. They wear hats that have the same color as the Nurse Joy they work for. In ''[[BW022|A Venipede Stampede!]]'', the Nurse Joy of [[Castelia City]] used her Audino to help calm down the {{p|Venipede}} that were attacking the city with {{m|Heal Pulse}}. Two of Nurse Joy's Audino were among the seven Audino controlled by {{TRT}} in ''[[BW035|Where Did You Go, Audino?]]''. In the end, the two Audino joined the others in releasing a burst of elemental attacks at the villains. ====={{aniseries|XY}}===== [[File:Audinite anime.png|thumb|250px|Audino's Audinite]] In ''[[XY096|A Giga Battle with Mega Results!]]'', a Kalos Nurse Joy who used an Audino instead of a {{TP|Nurse Joy|Wigglytuff}} was introduced. She had been assigned an experienced Audino instead of a Wigglytuff because of her tendency to forget her surroundings when focused on tasks. Despite the two constantly arguing with one another, they were still close enough to allow Audino to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] with the [[Audinite]] that Joy had recently discovered. Using its new power, Audino helped to defeat {{TRT}}, who were trying to steal all the [[Poké Ball]]s from the Pokémon Center. ===={{aniseries|HZ}}==== An Audino appeared in a fantasy in ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]''. ===Personality and characteristics=== Like almost all Pokémon helping Nurse Joys, Audino have caring and helpful personalities, being ready to assist their human partners in helping injured and sick Pokémon.
